messages.no_location: No air quality location is set. Add a place in Preferences, Places, or choose your city in Preferences, Air Quality.
messages.no_data: No air quality data for {place} right now. Please try again later.
messages.stale_notice: Showing the last air quality from {time}.
messages.err_offline: Could not reach the air quality service. Check your internet connection.
messages.err_service: The air quality service is not responding properly. Please try again later.
messages.err_bad_response: The air quality service sent data Hariku could not read. Please try again later.
messages.tip_good: Air quality is good; a fine time to be active outside.
messages.tip_moderate: Unusually sensitive people should consider reducing prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion.
messages.tip_sensitive: People with heart or lung disease, older adults, children and teenagers should reduce prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion.
messages.tip_unhealthy: Everyone should reduce prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion; sensitive groups should avoid it.
messages.tip_very_unhealthy: Everyone should avoid prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion; sensitive groups should avoid all physical activity outdoors.
messages.tip_hazardous: Everyone should avoid all physical activity outdoors.
messages.lbl_search: City to search for, for its own place (press Enter to search):
messages.lbl_results_count: Search results, {count} found. Select your city, then press OK:
messages.chk_alert: Announce once a day when the air becomes unhealthy (index 151 or more)
messages.note_index: The index is the US Air Quality Index (US AQI, 0 to 500) of the U.S. EPA. Its categories are like those of Indonesia's ISPU, but the numbers are worked out differently, so they may not match ISPU readings.
messages.note_area: Air quality comes from a global model (CAMS) with cells about 40 kilometres across, about 10 in Europe. The numbers describe the wider area, not a single street.
messages.note_tips: The tips follow the U.S. EPA's general guidance for each category. They are not medical advice.
messages.note_privacy: Open-Meteo gets the place rounded to about 1 kilometre, never the exact point.
messages.search_too_short: Type at least 2 letters of the city name.
messages.search_found_one: 1 place found. Select it in the search results, then press OK.
messages.search_found: {count} places found. Select your city in the search results, then press OK.
messages.lbl_hours: Next hours at {place} (PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic metre):
messages.forecast_no_data: No air quality data here right now. Please try again later.
